mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% consistently compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as investors shift from fixed income to equities.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 5.5% in a 3-month window signals labor market deterioration, triggering immediate equity sell-offs and negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 5.5% over 3 months, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad demand contraction, predicting negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days as recession risks escalate.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production above 105 combined with unemployment below 5.0% defines a supply-driven expansion regime, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days as manufacturing growth supports earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods meeting the trigger condition, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI acceleration exceeding 0.5% within 2 months signals persistent inflation, prompting delayed Fed easing and negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 0.5%, or Rank IC < 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Retail sales (RSAFS) consistently above its 12-month moving average drives positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days as consumer spending fuels corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS > 12-month MA, or Rank IC < 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in employment (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) signal labor market contraction, predicting negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days as recession fears intensify.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises, or Rank IC < 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production falling below 100 for two consecutive months indicates manufacturing contraction, causing negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days as recession risks increase.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 100 for two months, or Rank IC < 0.02.
